About Me

I build systems that scale.

From enterprise supply chains to cloud-native deployments.

I'm a Backend & DevOps Engineer at e2open — one of the world's largest supply chain SaaS platforms, serving enterprise clients across 60+ countries. Day-to-day I work with Java, Spring Boot, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Google Cloud Platform.

Before finishing my B.Tech (CGPA 9.21) at Anurag University, I was already contributing to production systems. I think about code from a systems design perspective — every feature I build gets designed with reliability, observability, and deployment in mind.

I hold 10+ GCP certifications — not because I had to, but because I wanted to deeply understand the infrastructure I deploy on. I'm currently open to Backend, DevOps, and Full Stack roles in Bangalore or hybrid setups.
